### D.5 Proposals for files this design does not edit (r7)

The r7 revision changes the carrier's mechanics, its placement map and the EVM mount. It changes no pin, threshold, timing or firmware requirement (G). The following table gives the r7 proposal for each file that this design does not edit.

| File | r7 proposal |
|---|---|
| `CLAUDE.md` | No change beyond the D.4 bodge record. The record gains the r7 items (tab X, tab Y, FT1/FT2 with their beds, the FT2 fill hole, the r7 sheet, the EVM plate, R276) and is added under the never-rotated hardware records once the carrier is built |
| `teensy_controller/teensy_controller.ino` | No change: r7 changes no pin, direction, threshold or timing |
| `WORK_QUEUE.md` | One queue item for the operator measurements MS1-MS8 with their gates (text below) |
| `references/Scale Car Teensy IO - IO.csv` | No change (D.3) |

The proposed `WORK_QUEUE.md` item is:

```
- BQ25798EVM carrier r7: operator measurements MS1-MS8 (docs/charger_bq25798_wiring_design_2026-11-05.md, T-A-08).
  Gates: MS1 (Ag105 standoff at four corners, module top height, module mass; gate D-2) before PM1.
  MS2-MS7 before PM0: MS2 enclosure and chassis room (lid clearance, EVM plate position, the 45.3 mm past the MB -x
  edge for corridor fallback (i), chassis clearance under the MB, USB plug and bend) -> W-lead route maxima;
  MS3 unrecorded items inside each tab outline + 0.5 mm and under each foot spot, L-FC body -> tab outlines;
  MS4 LM1084 thermal survey -> thermal band; MS5 vibration -> foot design (T-F-18 after the build);
  MS6 MB and CR thickness -> post arithmetic, foot height; MS7 EVM as received -> clamp design.
  MS8 fab rules (stack-up, L4 tenting, inside-corner router radius, 2 oz minimum space) before the PM0 DFM check.
  A tab trim re-runs docs/reviews/charger_eval_2026-11-05/round4/calc/r7_calc.py. Until MS2, every W lead stays
  within 0.30 m (T-A-02).
```
